sourceNote: A copy of the mesh assets/models/monkey/monkey.glb (armSource) with new quad tubes on each arm from the shoulder line to the wrist, 1.2 times longer than the arms of the source. tools/blender/arm_rebuild.py --factor 1.2 makes these faces. The other faces and monkey.glb stay unchanged.
armSourceNote: The source mesh (assets/models/monkey/README.md). tools/blender/arm_rebuild.py reads it.
paintedNote: The weights of the clavicles and the arms are the automatic weights of Blender with the weight rules of tools/blender/arm_rebuild.py. The vertices on the bones of paintedLower keep the rule weights, as on the wolf.

armSegments.note: Each upper arm and each forearm has 4 deform segments, and each elbow and wrist a helper bone. The helper is twice the gap of the elbow rings of tools/blender/arm_rebuild.py (step_skeleton() prints it).

name: Monkey

app.note: No reference image shows a monkey. The scale is 1.1726 m for each unit, so the skull top is at 1.132 m, the standing shoulder joints at 0.59 u (0.692 m), and H is 0.334 m.

armFactorNote: The factor 1 keeps the arm length, because the rig with arm segments does not stretch the arms. The arms of monkey-arms.glb are 1.2 times longer than the arms of the source (arm_rebuild.py --factor 1.2), and the arm joints are the joints of the longer arms, so the reach stays app.reach. The monkey plays a smaller trumpet at the scale 0.65 (SpeciesParams.trumpetScale, SPECIES_WIND_HOLDS.monkey of src/pose/winds.ts).
legFactorNote: The legs keep the length of the mesh. Do not stretch the legs: change the chair.
jointsNote: The places are in the studio units and axes of the source pose: 1 unit from the soles to the top of the tuft of hair, the soles at y = 0, +z forward, +x the left side. The right side mirrors the left side. The tail is a chain of two bones from the haunch over a bend behind the right foot to the tip of the curl. The joints of the elbow, the wrist, and the paw are the joints of the longer arms of arm_rebuild.py --factor 1.2.

studio.bindArmsNote: With straightArms, bindArms.upper_arm sets the bind upper arm. bindArms.forearm sets only the elbow axis: the cross product of the bind upper arm and this forearm direction (StudioBody.hinges, bind_hinges() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py). The two directions are the directions of the bent bind of the trumpet hold. Thus the elbow axes and the zero of the roll of the upper arm stay. The paw has no bind direction, because it keeps the turn of the upper arm.
studio.straightArmsNote: The bind keeps the arms of the source straight: the forearm and the paw keep the turn of the upper arm. Thus the rest shape holds the bend of no role, and each hold bends the elbow and the wrist from the same shape (the role-neutral bind of design 4.4).
studio.bindSupinationNote: The bind paw of each arm turns about its bind forearm toward supination, the left 118 degrees and the right 70 degrees (paw_supination() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py). The forearm segments share the turn. Each value makes the largest paw twist p95 of the six roles of the cast matrix and the trumpet smallest (design 4.4). This largest twist is about 133 degrees on the left (the flute and the snare drum) and 86 degrees on the right (the cello and the snare drum). With no supination, it is about 170 degrees on the left and 156 degrees on the right.
studio.note: The monkey has no chair and stands in this pose (SpeciesParams.noChair). The thigh slopes 65 degrees down and 15 degrees out, and the shin slants 20 degrees back, so that the feet stand under the hips (tools/rig/leg_turns.py <config> 65 15 -20). The trunk leans forward, so that the center of mass stays over the soles.

tail.note: The vertices within radius of the line of the tail bones, and behind the plane z = behind, follow the tail bones. The plane keeps the backs of the legs out of the tail.

haunch.note: The part of the thigh weight that goes to the hips grows from 0 at the lower height to 1 at the upper height, so that the buttocks stay on the hips. This is the rule of the dog, moved with the joints of the monkey.

weights.note: Beyond the plane |x| = armSplit, only the free arm follows the arm bones. Above headFrom (the chin), each vertex follows the head only. earBase lies above the head, so the round ears follow the head.

flip.note: The values of the rabbit and the fox.

refine.ringsNote: The config has no rings. pnpm rig-mesh monkey --check lists the thin faces near the joints as candidates for a ring (check.thin).

smile.note: The texture has a thin smile line, but each face takes the mean of its samples, so the line goes away. The band colors 5 faces of the lower lip and its corners in a mid brown of the fur. outward 0.6 keeps the side faces out of the line.

colors.note: A face is dark when at least eyeShare of its samples have a linear luminance below dark. The limit 0.02 keeps the dark brown hands and feet out of the dark faces. A dark face in the eye box is an eye, and a brown face in the nose box is the nose and takes the gloss.

chair.note: The app builds no chair under the monkey, but the rig needs a chair for the seat height of the export. The config has no sit rule, so the haunch keeps its form. The seat top is the lowest point of the seated body over the seat.
